value.rationale: The exact exponent is a natural conditioning/integrability invariant for a structured Gaussian sketch and changes by a large factor solely through the row offset gcd; cycle parity exactly doubles the leading coefficient. Almost-sure full rank does not ensure finite expected inverse amplification. This provides a reproducible sharp model relevant to subsampled convolution and numerical inversion rather than a routine special-case recomputation.
